 Missing Sailor, Dog Rescued 500 Miles Off California 
 86-year-old hadn't been heard from since August 
 By 
 Arden Dier 
 with Newser.AI 
 Posted Nov 2, 2026 7:28 AM CST 
 Copied 
 A carrier picks up an 86-year-old sailor and his dog.   ( US Coast Guard ) 
 An 86-year-old sailor and his dog have been found alive in the Pacific more than two months after they went silent. The Coast Guard says the man set out from Astoria, Ore., bound for Pago Pago in American Samoa, but no one heard from him after Aug. 20, People reports. A report that he was overdue came in Oct. 24, and three days later an alert from his boat's emergency beacon pinged. 
 A search plane spotted his damaged sailboat, Willow Wind, about 460 miles off San Diego. Rough seas initially thwarted a cargo carrier's rescue attempt, but the crew eventually pulled the pair aboard on Wednesday evening. A helicopter then airlifted them to San Diego; medics said the man was weak but had no serious injuries. His vessel was left adrift, per the New York Post . The Coast Guard says the case serves as a reminder to carry emergency gear and file a float plan.
